description: This Java class 'CatalogWorker' provides utility methods for managing product catalogs within the OFBiz framework, including retrieving catalog IDs, categories, and configuration flags, as well as handling current catalog context.

classes.name: CatalogWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for catalog management, including retrieval of catalog IDs, categories, and configuration flags, as well as managing current catalog context.

methods.name: getAllCatalogIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all catalog IDs available in the system.

methods.name: getStoreCatalogs
methods.description: Retrieves catalogs associated with a specific product store.

methods.name: getPartyCatalogs
methods.description: Retrieves catalogs associated with a specific party (user).

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories for a given product catalog and category type.

methods.name: getCurrentCatalogId
methods.description: Determines the current catalog ID based on request parameters, session, or defaults.

methods.name: getCatalogIdsAvailable
methods.description: Returns catalog IDs available based on party and store associations.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specified catalog.

methods.name: getContentPathPrefix
methods.description: Gets the content path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getTemplatePathPrefix
methods.description: Gets the template path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getProdCatalog
methods.description: Fetches the catalog entity for a given catalog ID.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific category ID within a catalog based on category type.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the top-level category ID for browsing.

methods.name: getCatalogSearchCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID used for search filtering.

methods.name: getCatalogViewAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows viewing all items.

methods.name: getCatalogPurchaseAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows purchase permissions.

methods.name: getCatalogPromotionsCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID for promotions.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddUse
methods.description: Checks if quick add feature is enabled for the catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategoryPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves the primary quick add category ID.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategories
methods.description: Gets list of categories for quick add.

methods.name: getCatalogTopEbayCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves the eBay root category ID for the catalog.
